route_note: Take a train from Paris Saint-Lazare to Vernon-Giverny, then a short shuttle bus or taxi to the gardens.

route_note: Direct TGV or regional trains from Paris Gare de l'Est reach Reims in about 45-90 minutes; champagne houses are a short walk or taxi from the station.
